text:
CapCut Video Studio is our latest web-based, timeline-free AI production workspace, with Dreamina Seedance 2.0 supported. Here's a quick video to help you get started!

This video walks you through the basics of the new unlimited canvas + AI agent workflow, and shows you how to go from a single idea to your first AI short film or episode. 

New to AI video creation? This is the perfect place to begin.

Experienced creators - another tutorial is coming up with more advanced techniques. Stay tuned!
content:
Sign in on the CapCut website, then open AI Studio → Video Studio from the left sidebar to access Dreamina Seedance 2.0 in CapCut Video Studio
Use the free starter credits in CapCut Video Studio to begin generating with Dreamina Seedance 2.0
